label: Replicache + oRPC push/pull
licence: roci.dev terms; source released and no longer charged for, repository archived 2026-06-10.

pgCapture.note: No Postgres integration at all: you write the pull endpoint and a version/cookie scheme yourself.

partialSync.note: Whatever your pull endpoint returns, so tenant scoping is trivially ours, but every partial-sync mechanism is hand-built.

offlineWrites.note: Mutators plus a durable local mutation queue was the original strength; rebase-on-pull conflict model is well documented.

permissions.note: Push/pull are our own oRPC procedures, so RLS and can() apply unchanged. The only engine that reuses PAP-34 directly.

bundle.note: Small client, IndexedDB persistence, no WASM.

targets.note: Runs in any WebView; same IndexedDB-in-Tauri caveat.

selfHostLicence.note: No server component of theirs to host; licence is now free but not a standard OSI licence.

maturity.note: HARD FAIL: repository archived 2026-06-10, maintenance mode, no new features, vendor tells existing users to migrate to Zero. Last npm release 2025-07-02.

ergonomics.note: Good primitives, but every query, index and diff is hand-written.

exit.note: Everything on the server is ours already.
